subject: general
question: Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. K sits third to the left of L. I sits to the immediate left of L. D sits to the immediate left of J. J sits second to the left of C. Who sits third to the right of B?
solution: **Given: **Seven people B, C, D, I, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. 1. K sits third to the left of L. 2. I sits to the immediate left of L. 3. D sits to the immediate left of J. 4. J sits second to the left of C.
